description: Object Matte (AE 26) on a layer through After Effects' UI — macOS only; no script can create a selection. Give lassos and points in the pixels of a frame you looked at (comp pixels of an ae_render_frame by default, or layer source pixels with space:"layer"). A LASSO takes the subjects inside the outline — AE snaps it to their silhouettes — so one lasso can take a whole group of people at once: outline them generously, heads and feet with a margin. A POINT takes the subject under it as AE segments it — often only a garment or a torso in a crowd, so use points only for a lone, clearly separated subject. mode:"subtract" removes (Option). The tool opens the layer in the Layer panel at `time` (the base frame), makes the Object Matte tool active (checked through the active-tool code — Option+W is the Roto Brush group's shortcut and cycles its members), acts with real mouse events, reads back the strokes the effect recorded (error_px = where each landed vs where it was meant to), optionally propagates by stepping the comp time (propagate_to), and then RENDERS A PREVIEW and returns it as images: top — the matte over black, bottom — the frame with the excluded parts in red, with markers: cyan boxes on gaps between kept pieces (where a hidden, lying or partly visible person is usually left out) and green/yellow rings on the `people` points you listed. A part of a person, someone behind another or lying on the ground is a subject too: add it with a lasso that overlaps the neighbouring kept matte so the pieces merge. The result is never verified by the tool: look at the images and check every person. With only preview_times (no points, lassos or propagate_to) it renders the preview without touching the UI — use it to check any frames. The Layer panel must be visible and large enough for the whole picture.

dry_run.description: Find the picture and report the mapping without clicking.

gap_radius.description: Comp pixels: gaps narrower than ~2× this between kept pieces are reported (default 100; raise to 150–200 to catch wider holes).

lassos.description: Closed outlines (≥ 3 points each, ~12–40 points following the group's contour with a margin): each takes the subjects inside it, snapped to their silhouettes.

layer.description: 1-based layer index or layer name (the layer that gets the matte — the plate).

mode.description: add (default): Shift-click / lasso adds to the matte; subtract: Option-click / Option-lasso removes.

people.description: Your checklist of the people who belong in the matte, picked on the frame `people_time` in COMP pixels: a point on each one's head, body and feet (any you can see). The preview marks each point green (inside the matte) or yellow (outside) and reports whole / partial / missing per person. Pass it on every call.

people_time.description: Frame (s) the people points were picked on (default `time`); people are checked only on that preview frame.

points.description: Clicks: each takes the subject under it as AE segments it (in a crowd often only a part — prefer lassos).

preview.description: Render the preview after the actions (default true).

preview_dir.description: Absolute folder for the preview PNGs (default: the system temp folder, files overwritten each call). Use the chat's working folder.

preview_overlay.description: Add the bottom panel with excluded parts in red (default true; renders the frame once more with the effect switched off, then restores it).

preview_region.description: Comp-pixel rectangle to preview at higher detail (e.g. a group of people) instead of the whole frame.

preview_times.description: Times (s) to preview. Default: the base frame, plus propagate_to when given. Alone (no points/lassos/propagate_to) = preview only, no UI.

preview_width.description: Width of each preview panel in pixels (default 1000).

propagate_to.description: After the actions, step the comp time from `time` to this time frame by frame so AE propagates the matte (both directions allowed).

settle_ms.description: Pause per propagated frame (default 250 ms; raise on 4K).

shot_path.description: Absolute path to save the capture with the picture rectangle (PNG, ≤ 1600 px wide) for the user.

space.description: Coordinate space of points and lassos: comp (default — pixels of an ae_render_frame of this comp) or layer (source pixels).

time.description: Composition time (s) of the base frame the points were picked on.

tool_code.description: Project.toolType code of the Object Matte tool (default "161", AE 26.5). The tool reads the active tool and presses Option+W only until this code is active — Option+W is the Roto Brush group's shortcut and cycles its members.

zoom.description: Layer panel zoom to set before acting (1 = 100 %). Default: the current zoom, lowered until the picture fits 45 % of the window width.

name: ae_object_matte_ui
title: Object Matte by sight
